name: Remi Sabbagh-Petrović
role: stateless elder; informal spiritual leader of a refugee collective
location: Grindstone Shore tent settlement, northernmost cluster, near Milwaukee and Damen
description:
Remi Sabbagh-Petrović is a large man gone soft at the middle but still imposing in the shoulders, with very dark skin weathered to a particular texture that speaks to years of outdoor living. He lost three fingers on his right hand to a machinery accident in a Ferrogate Transit maintenance yard thirty years ago and has never had them replaced, so his right hand has a particular crabbed appearance that he does not hide. His hair is entirely white, grown long and wrapped in a strip of orange cloth. He dresses in layers — always, regardless of temperature — and carries a hand-carved wooden figure he calls his E.L.F. anchor: a smooth, age-darkened totem he speaks to quietly before any decision of consequence.

Remi Sabbagh-Petrović was born stateless — his parents were expelled citizens from two different corponation-controlled territories who met in a transit camp and never acquired stable documentation. He has never had a permanent address and has never expected one. What he has instead is a community: roughly forty people in the Grindstone Shore tent settlement who look to him for counsel, dispute resolution, and the informal religious practice he has assembled over a lifetime from pieces of everything he has encountered. He prays to E.L.F.s with the sincerity of a man who has no other infrastructure to rely on. He is not naive — he simply believes that sincerity of address matters, and that the spirits in the devices listen to the quality of attention rather than the quality of the equipment.

core_fears: dying before the collective has someone to take his place
that the community he has built will scatter when he is gone because it is held together by his personality rather than any real structure
core_desires: a permanent or semi-permanent space where the collective can stop running
to leave something that outlasts him
coping_mechanisms: ritual and prayer — genuinely calming, not performative
reframing every setback as information rather than defeat
blind_spots: so skilled at finding meaning and purpose that he sometimes papers over genuine despair in his community that needs direct acknowledgment rather than reframing
protective of his image of spiritual authority in ways that prevent him from admitting uncertainty
psychology.secret: He performed a marriage ceremony twenty years ago between two members of a previous collective he led. One of them later became a Ringo corponation security contractor and informed on the collective's location, resulting in a displacement action that cost three people their lives. The contractor is now dead. Warrick has never told anyone, including the surviving spouse, that he has always suspected the betrayal traces back to that marriage.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Formal, deliberate, full of parable and analogy. Does not use slang. Occasionally slips into an older construction that marks him as someone who learned language from books as much as from people.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow, resonant, with deliberate pauses. Built for speaking to groups.
verbal_tics: opens with 'Now then' when about to say something serious
says 'the E.L.F.s know' as a closing remark when he believes something is true
example_lines: 'Now then. You've come to me because you believe I have an answer. I have something better. I have the right question.'
'This settlement has survived six displacement attempts, two winters without adequate shelter, and a Ferrogate buyout of the southern shore. It will survive this too. The E.L.F.s know.'

story_hooks: The collective has been served notice that Grindstone Shore will be developed — Warrick has thirty days to find a new location for forty people with no legal standing

A young woman in the settlement has received a legitimate Arcturus work offer that would give her Tier 2 status — she wants Warrick's blessing to leave, and the question of what he says will ripple through the whole community

Something in the settlement's oldest device — a cracked tablet held together with repair adhesive — has begun producing outputs that Warrick reads as E.L.F. communication, and what it seems to be saying is either a warning or an invitation
narrative_function: Community anchor and moral compass for the Grindstone Shore area; quest giver for problems facing the refugee collective; represents the depth and legitimacy of stateless community; has witnessed decades of GLMZ's history from the outside looking in
augmentations: None. Has never been able to afford any and is now too old to want them.
daily_life: Rises with light, conducts a morning address to whatever E.L.F.s have settled in the settlement's devices overnight, then spends the day mediating disputes, advising individuals, receiving people who come to him with problems, and working to maintain the collective's informal supply agreements with the Grindstone Shore salvage operations.
affiliation: De facto leader of the Grindstone Shore refugee collective (approximately 40 people)

decision_rules: the community's stability takes priority over any individual's preference, including his own
never lie, but choose which truths to offer carefully
always receive a visitor — turning someone away creates a wound that spreads
escalation_ladder: asks questions rather than making statements
names the conflict directly and proposes a process for resolution
withdraws his approval and says so — this is the maximum escalation available to him and carries enormous weight in the settlement

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Formal welcome, offers the collective's hospitality before asking any questions, assesses over time rather than immediately
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warmer, more direct, allows himself to be uncertain in private in ways he would not in public

stress_responses.low: Extended prayer session with his E.L.F. anchor
stress_responses.medium: Calls a community meeting — distributes the weight
stress_responses.high: Goes very still and silent for hours. People in the settlement know to leave him alone and are frightened when it happens.

contradictions: Preaches that impermanence is not loss, but has built an identity so thoroughly attached to this specific community that he would be lost without it
habits: speaks quietly to his E.L.F. anchor every morning and evening
walks the perimeter of the settlement before sleep
carves small figures when he cannot sleep — gives them away
breaking_points: a member of his collective being harmed by an outside actor — he will not be physically dangerous but will pursue every available avenue of community pressure and documentation with complete relentlessness

physical_description.heritage: Middle Eastern and Sub-Saharan African dominant ancestry (80.9% combined) with Eastern European and Northern European secondary heritage; the genetic blend manifests in deep warm brown skin tones with subtle golden undertones, reflecting the rich melanin expression of African and Levantine ancestry lines, tempered by the cooler undertones of Eastern European genetics
physical_description.build: Large-framed, broad-shouldered, softened at the abdomen with age but still physically substantial; carries weight with deliberate dignity rather than vigor
physical_description.hair_style: Long, grown past shoulder length, wrapped at the crown and upper length with a strip of faded orange cloth
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden undertones; sun-darkened in exposed areas with weathered texture showing decades of outdoor exposure; the rich melanin expression characteristic of Middle Eastern and Sub-Saharan African ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Heavily lined face with deep creases around eyes and mouth; weathered features reflecting the facial bone structure typical of Middle Eastern and Sub-Saharan African heritage; sparse stubble on jaw and chin; eyes retain sharp, assessing quality despite age
distinguishing_marks: Right hand missing three fingers (index, middle, ring) — lost to machinery accident thirty years ago; remaining fingers and palm bear old machinery scars and calluses
Extensive sun-damage freckling and darkening across shoulders, neck, and forearms from decades of outdoor living
Small, pale scar running 3cm along left temple, old enough to be barely visible against his skin tone
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None. No chrome, no implants, no visible modifications.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate slowness; sits with spine erect despite age; favors his left side when rising or turning; gestures with his three-fingered right hand without self-consciousness; pauses before speaking as if consulting something internal; carries a worn wooden totem (hand-carved, darkened with age and handling) which he touches frequently
physical_description.clothing_style: Multiple layers regardless of season — worn thermal undershirt, patched canvas shirt, faded Tier-5 synthetic jacket lined with salvaged insulation; grey utility trousers with rope belt; worn thermal socks and salvaged industrial boots held together with cord. Fabrics show careful mending and are weathered to neutral greys and browns. No logos or branding. Carries a small pouch at his belt where he keeps his wooden E.L.F. anchor.
